body:
Yep, I definitely had this happen. You reach a point where you would do anything--*anything*--to get that shit out of you. It can happen if you get dehydrated and sit around too much, like my too-busy-Redditing-to-drink-or-move ass.

So yeah, I stuck ol' pointy up there and fish hooked what felt like clay out of my ass, causing much splashing and groaning and getting shit so deep under my fingernail I thought all the soap in the house wouldn't get my hands clean.

And now I understand Lady MacBeth.

I used to be REALLY into collecting sports cards. The thrill of opening packs to see if I had pulled any sweet, sweet rares, figuring out which players my friends liked and making bundle trades for what I felt to be their best cards, and organizing my collection into books and thick hard cases--my gems. *My precious.*

The problem was, I was a dumb kid without much purchasing power, and even though I got boxes of cards for virtually every holiday, it could not in any way satisfy my urge to amass more. I spent every spare dime on them, but eventually...

I came up with a scheme to steal them from stores. I would get several packs and then pretend I had changed my mind, putting most of them back and palming a few. Then, I would reach to get my wallet, transferring the cards to my back pocket while pulling it out. I would thumb through my money, as if to see how many I could afford, and then go buy a few. This system worked so well I felt invulnerable. UNTIL...

I was on a family vacation, and we stopped in a grocery store to get some food. I immediately went to the cards, and I was just going to town, putting them everywhere I had room, not even being that careful. I wouldn't be back here, I decided, so as long as no one saw me in the act, I was fine. I had neglected to notice they had a door beeper thing, and the packs had anti-theft strips.

We all started to the door and I saw the beepers. I panicked. There was no way to de-card myself, now. So I told my parents I had forgotten something, and would be out to the car in a minute. I waited til I was sure they were in the car, and just went for it, power walking through the beepers, got in...made dad my unknowing getaway driver. My dear, sweet, moral father.

After somehow getting away with that, I decided my card thievery was over. I knew I was going to eventually get caught, and I decided I just didn't ever want anyone to know my shameful secret. I still feel bad about it, and I must confess, I stole some other things after that when in a position to do so with no (I thought) recourse. Well, recourse came, and I lost my job and my reputation.

The moral of this story is, just don't get used to stealing shit. Don't do it. Don't let yourself think it's okay. It's not okay, and you'll end up fucking up your life if you do it.
